Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo which reads as hereunder:
"In the event of the compensation amount having been deposited before the City Civil and Sessions Court, the undersigned counsel for the petitioner prays to file necessary application before the appropriate forum and in light of the same withdraw the present petition."
In light of the memo filed, petition is dismissed as not pressed.
